Container.Name: immich_chromacluster
Container.Overview: ChromaCluster — Smart Immich Album Creator powered by advanced multi-signal feature analysis. Automatically discovers and proposes albums by fusing GPS coordinates, Immich machine learning visual analysis (CLIP Smart Search & facial recognition), perceptual CIELAB chroma/color-tone clustering, EXIF camera & lighting metadata, and time patterns, with human-in-the-loop review before syncing to Immich.
Container.Requires: An active Immich server and an Immich API key created under Account Settings -> API Keys.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the ChromaCluster review dashboard.

Config.Name: AppData Directory
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the SQLite CIELAB feature cache, thumbnails, and sync ledger.

Config.Name: Immich Server URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your Immich server (e.g. http://immich:2283 or https://photos.yourdomain.com).

Config.Name: Immich API Key
Config.Description: Immich API key with asset.read, asset.view, album.read, album.create, and albumAsset.create permissions (or All).

Config.Name: Scan Interval (Hours)
Config.Description: Background incremental scan interval in hours.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Internal container path for SQLite storage.
